evals.name: System preference detection
evals.prompt: Add dark mode that defaults to the user's system preference

evals.name: Manual toggle
evals.prompt: Add a dark/light mode toggle button with localStorage persistence
assertions: Falls back to system preference when no saved choice

evals.name: FOUC prevention
evals.prompt: Prevent the flash of wrong theme on page load

evals.name: Smooth transition
evals.prompt: Make the theme switch animate smoothly instead of snapping
assertions: No transition on initial page load

evals.name: WCAG contrast
evals.prompt: Ensure all text has sufficient contrast in both themes
assertions: No low-contrast gray text on dark backgrounds

evals.name: Component-specific colors
evals.prompt: Style cards, buttons, and code blocks for both themes
assertions: Cards have appropriate background per theme
Borders and shadows adjust per theme

evals.name: Anti-pattern detection
evals.prompt: Review this dark mode: body { background: black; color: white; } .error { color: red; }
